about_the_game:
Though your home island was prosperous when you moved away five years ago, something terrible has happened. Your childhood friend, Mikoto, has called you back because both tourists and locals are collapsing one after another, drained of their life force.

The cause? Ancient succubi have awakened, possessed women on the island, and begun to consume the vigor of its dwellers. At this rate, the island's popular tourism industry will implode, and everyone who lives there will suffer financial ruin. Work together with Mikoto, who's awakened to her powers as a shrine maiden, to save your home!

In this first-person dungeon-crawling RPG, you'll have to carefully explore every floor to find your way to the depths of each dungeon and defeat its boss succubus. There are switches, traps, and pitfalls along the way, which must be triggered or avoided to reach your destination.

Every floor has hidden treasure that will help you on your way. Carefully clear maps or head straight to your destination; the choice is yours.

In turn-based battles, use abilities gained from Mikoto's skill tree to quickly defeat your enemies before she takes too much damage.

Map Out Complex Dungeons

As you explore the grid-based dungeons, each new cell will be added to your map. Navigate the winding corridors, collecting treasure and defeating enemies!

Become Closer to Mikoto

All work and no play? That's not fun at all! Hang out with Mikoto between dungeon delves, enjoying island attractions like the beach and the water park.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 8/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 11/10/8
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
